title: Objective-Horizon Mapping and Interlock Sprint Protocol
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Create a repeatable protocol that maps company-level objectives across three planning horizons (Immediate quarter, Next quarter, Strategic 12-month) and defines a sprint-level interlock process so engineering, product, and design teams can commit to initiative boundaries, escalation lanes, and measurable rollups.
background: Over the last two cycles we've seen misalignment between company-level objectives and the sprint commitments of cross-functional teams. This causes scope churn during mid-quarter planning, unclear success metrics for feature work, and late discoveries of dependent work owned by other teams. We need a clear, operational protocol that lives in Linear + dashboards so owners can surface risks earlier and stakeholders can make trade-offs with data.
proposal: 1) Define a three-horizon objective matrix that ties each company objective to 1-3 priority initiatives, owners, and leading indicators. 2) Implement a weekly 'Interlock Sprint Check' ritual for the first six weeks of each quarter where initiative owners sync with dependent teams. 3) Add structured tags and templates in Linear for objective-linked tickets (e.g., objective:rev-ops, initiative:obs-3). 4) Build a small dashboard in Looker/Metabase that rolls up initiative health (traffic light) and top 3 risks per objective.
acceptance_criteria: Objective matrix (CSV + Confluence doc) published and reviewed by execs
Linear ticket template with objective and initiative fields deployed and adopted by >= 80% of PMs
Weekly interlock ritual schedule and owner list published; first 4 sessions executed with minutes
Dashboard shows live rollups for all company objectives and is accessible to execs and PMs
Escalation ladder documented with SLAs for decisions (48h for blocker triage, 5 business days for capacity trade-off)
